prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1089; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, muscle stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The injury mechanism is consistent with the reported collision, and the presenting symptoms are plausible for this type of impact. Over the course of eleven visits, care followed a conventional progression that included evaluation, manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue strain of the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known to the provider or documented in available records. Treatment frequency tapered as the patient's pain and mobility improved, and the patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program. Billing for services reflects single, non-duplicated charges for each visit and procedure.
